highlights.title: Police begin operation to move migrants from Ceuta beaches
highlights.summary: Police reportedly fired into the air on Friday morning as they struggled to contain crowds jostling to secure a place at the tented site.

highlights.title: Dozens of suspected illegal miners die in Nigerian custody
highlights.summary: Authorities linked the deaths to disease, but this has been disputed by intelligence reports and relatives of the accused.

highlights.title: Por que vilarejo britânico votou para se separar do Reino Unido
highlights.summary:
Moradores de uma vila em Oxfordshire votaram pela independência do Reino Unido em um referendo simbólico realizado em protesto contra os planos de abrigar mais de 1.000 imigrantes em uma antiga base militar.

highlights.title: German Art Institutions Prepare for a Fight as Far Right Looks to Take Power
highlights.summary: As the Alternative for Germany party seeks to control a state government for the first time, its push for “patriotic” art has drawn comparisons with Nazi policies.

highlights.title: Lindsay Clancy holdout juror had no doubt she deliberately killed her children
highlights.summary: It is the first time the juror, who refused to side with the others and acquit Clancy, has spoken publicly about his decision.
